- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)

- **MFA must be optional, OFF by default** — owner was very angry it was enforced
- **NEVER deploy mid-job** — deploying restarts the Render service which orphans the in-flight worker, causing jobs to get stuck at whatever stage they were in (TESTING, PATCHING, etc.)

- Added `COMPLETED` as a new terminal state (separate from `VERIFIED`) — `VERIFIED` remains the success terminal only for full deploy + production-verify path; `COMPLETED` is the honest success terminal for commit-only / QA-only / read-only / factory tasks

- `deployRequested` threaded from `ivx-autonomous-coder.ts` (`input.executionMode === 'deploy'`) through worker result to state machine guard
- Do NOT change the autonomous coding engine — fix only the terminal-state completion rules
